selection: Host selects highest mean bidirectional validation Recall@5, without retraining; test once after selection. No winner selected in planning.
rationale: Linear/linear contrastive is a low-capacity baseline for 64-dimensional SVD inputs with 8776 training pairs.
MLP/MLP contrastive adds nonlinear capacity in each modality; higher overfitting risk than linear.
MLP RNA and linear ATAC selfsupervised reconstruction provide a different objective and asymmetric capacity; independent reconstruction may not align modalities.
architecture: Linear maps input directly to latent; MLP is input → 128 ReLU → latent. RNA is encoder1, ATAC encoder2. Fixed SVD inputs; trained projections are not foundation-model fine-tuning.
training: Contrastive uses symmetric paired InfoNCE, normalized embeddings and temperature 0.1; batch negatives can include biologically similar false negatives. Selfsupervised uses separate within-modality MSE reconstruction, not cross-modal prediction. Train-only imputation and scaling occur in train.py.
rejected: Supervised learning is infeasible without genuine labels. Deep MLP has greater capacity and overfitting and compute risk for 64-dimensional precomputed features; no architecture was benchmarked.
warnings: Randomized SVD produced divide-by-zero, overflow and invalid matmul warnings; both fits were rejected and warning-free finite ARPACK fits used. Explained variance sums RNA 0.2398, ATAC 0.1926; substantial variance remains outside retained components.
